Treatment D = post_pri = 1 from the fund's first post-signing quarter (absorbing in calendar time, verified); gvar = gpost. fixest (fixef.rm = none) reproduces the log: coef 0.1088166 vs 0.1088166, N 3286 vs 3286, clusters 460 vs 460, SE 0.5194155 vs 0.519415. Regression sample: N = 3286, 460 funds, 41 consecutive quarters. Cohorts (first post-signing quarter): 39, of which 31 have both treated and untreated rows in the sample. In 40 of the 41 treated periods another cohort supplies untreated rows (not-yet-signed funds; no never-treated funds). Funds observed only after signing in the sample (always-treated within sample): 228 (25.2% of rows); funds observed only before signing: 16.
